title: Explicit Rank Extractors and Subspace Designs via Function Fields, with Applications to Strong Blocking Sets
summary: We give new explicit constructions of several fundamental objects in linear-algebraic pseudorandomness and combinatorics, including lossless rank extractors, weak subspace designs, and strong $s$-blocking sets over finite fields. Our focus is on the small-field regime, where the field size depends only on a secondary parameter (such as the rank or codimension) and is independent of the ambient dimension.
